tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Switchboard Finance's published information on Australian business finance types, criteria and licensing. Returns ids, titles and source URLs for citation. Example: {"query":"second mortgage LVR for a trust"}.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of one Switchboard Finance document by its id, with its source URL for citation. Example: {"id":"lane:caveat"}.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_callback, search, fetch · Private data: check_fit, list_products, request_callback, fetch · Public sink: request_callback · Destructive: request_callback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_callback, search, fetch · Private data: check_fit, list_products, request_callback, fetch · Public sink: request_callback · Destructive: request_callback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
